summary: All three prescriptions need review: genotype, a drug interaction and kidney function each affect one of them.

flags_explained.plain_explanation: Clopidogrel must be activated by CYP2C19. This patient's genotype produces little of the active form, so the guideline suggests an alternative antiplatelet.

suggestions_for_clinician_review.text: Consider reviewing the antiplatelet choice, as the guideline advises an alternative for poor metabolizers.
